text:
elaine.docs: Heads-up: we're rolling out a small but breaking change to the SDK/docs surface that affects the generation API parameter name.

We are renaming `response_mode` -> `response_format` across SDKs and examples to better reflect structured output variants. This will ship to hosted API and the docs site next week. Deprecation window: 45 days from the rollout.

Why: `response_mode` was ambiguous when we introduced structured output types; `response_format` maps directly to the enum we use in the runtime.

Migration TL;DR:
- SDKs will accept both keys for the 45-day window and emit a warning.
- Docs and samples will be updated to `response_format` immediately.
- Please update internal repos / infra configs to use `response_format` before the end of the window.

Migration guide (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/migration/response_format

samira.docs: Will the SDKs auto-shim incoming requests so older callers don't break?

jay.sdk: Yes — JS and Python SDKs will accept `response_mode` and map it to `response_format` for the 45-day period and log a one-line deprecation warning when the old key is used. Example (JS):

```js
// old
client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-1', response_mode: 'structured' })

// new
client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-1', response_format: 'structured' })
```

matt.eng: For Dedicated/Private customers, do we plan to auto-apply the compat shim in the control plane packages, or is this strictly a runtime/API change? We need to coordinate with infra teams so deployments don't get surprises.

elaine.docs: Good question. Plan is: hosted API will have the shim server-side for the full window. For Dedicated/Private: the runtime images will include the shim in the next patch release and we'll publish a migration note. We'll also ship a release artifact with the shim disabled for customers who prefer explicit enforcement — documented in the release notes.

rebecca.pe: I'll update the public-facing changelog and add a small banner to the docs home page linking to the migration guide. I'll also add a sample `grep` command for repos to find uses of `response_mode`.

tony.platform: Suggest adding a temporary lint rule to the internal monorepo that flags `response_mode` in JSON/YAML/.env so we catch config leaks before the deadline. I can open a PR against infra-ci today.

docs-bot: Reminder: Docs site rebuild scheduled Fri 03:00 UTC after the patch release. Expect short 5–10m downtime for the docs site.

elaine.docs: Action checklist (short):
- [x] SDKs: accept both keys + deprecation warning (jay)
- [x] Hosted API: server-side shim enabled on rollout (infra)
- [ ] Dedicated/Private: patch image + release notes (matt/tony)
- [x] Docs: migration guide published (rebecca)
- [ ] Monorepo lint rule to detect old key (tony)

If you're owning one of the unchecked items above, drop a quick :thumbsup: and add the PR link. We'll follow up in the weekly docs sync. Thanks everyone!
